messages:
Maya: quick proposal — introduce an "observability gate" in the embed autosplitter. only apply autosplit when preflight + historical confidence pass. want console visibility into split reasons/fallbacks.
Vik: sounds good. can you sketch the preflight check flow?
Maya: preflight returns estimate_units and a confidence score (0-100). gate rules: confidence >= 85 AND tenant_success_rate_last_1h >= 98% => allow split. else fallback to bytes-based fastpath.
Lucas: where does the historical tenant metric live? is it per-route in datadog or in our ingest events?
Maya: we'll add a new metric `embed.autosplit.allowed{tenant}` emitted at decision time. also logs: `split_reason=preflight,confidence=92,estimate=12`.
Ashley: console UX: add a per-tenant panel showing split rate, allowed/blocked counts, and average post-split latency. also expose the top 5 split_reasons.
Maya: +1. suggested telemetry keys: `split_decision`, `split_reason`, `preflight_conf`, `preflight_estimate_units`, `fallback_path`, `split_partitions`.
Vik: need to be careful with cardinality—tenant + route + reason is ok, but don't attach full vectors.
Maya: agreed. we will tag only tenant_id (hashed), route, and a coarse reason (preflight|size|safety|config). no extra metadata.
Lucas: how will this affect quotas? if we autosplit more, tenants could eat more units.
Maya: rollout will include a soft quota circuit: if tenant_daily_units > quota*1.1 then autosplit returns `allowed=false` and client sees 429 with `X-Embed-Fastpath: true` header.
Ashley: UX for that: console should flag tenants nearing autosplit throttle and provide a "simulate split" mode.
ingest-bot: deploy-bot: canary build 0.82 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T15:02Z
Vik: sample header we propose to surface to clients for opt-in/diagnostics:
```
X-Embed-Estimate: 12
X-Embed-Confidence: 92
X-Embed-Decision: split
X-Embed-Fallback: bytes
```
Maya: also emit histogram `embed.split.postsplit_latency_ms` with tag `split_decision` so console can show latency delta.
Lucas: alerting: create an SLO alert if post-split latency > baseline+30% for 5m and split_rate > 5%.
Ashley: for the console, add a small sparkline on the tenant page and a link to sample request/response traces.
Vik: rollout plan: fold into /embed preflight canary (config flag `enable_observability_gate`) -> 1% users -> 10% -> 50% -> all. monitor allowed/block ratios and unit consumption.
Maya: can we add a debug endpoint to query a tenant's split_history? maybe `/internal/tenant/{id}/embed-split-history` guarded by auth.
Lucas: keep it internal only, rate-limited. yes.
Ashley: who owns dashboard creation? product + platform. Maya can pair with me for initial widgets.
Maya: i'll add a PR with telemetry emitters + header polishing. will include a migration plan to backfill split_reason counts for last 48h using logs.
Vik: small nit — name the metric `embed.autosplit.decision` (counter) and a tag `reason`. that'll match other metrics.
Maya: SG. adding to PR. y'all ok with the rollout and console scope?
Lucas: looks good from runtime side.
Ashley: yep from UX side. thx!
Maya: thanks team. merging PR to canary tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
